_doc: Declared pavement that may lie off the lap: the road-inventory gate's exemption polygons (tools/verify_road_inventory.py; V3-PLAN P5 'road inventory', ledger 0048). Every pavement triangle of the BUILT track must lie within half-width + 2 m of the route [invented] or inside one of these polygons. Each entry names the AUTH_* object it covers (the hand-authored Blender object, P3); its polygon is drawn when that object is authored, from the aerial / the object itself, never before. An entry with no polygon exempts NOTHING: the gate lists it as unmeasured, so pavement built before its polygon is declared fails, which is the point. match 'footprint' = any pavement triangle inside the polygon is exempt; 'name_and_footprint' = only triangles of a group whose name contains the object name (the C-470 decks: the plan exempts them 'by name and footprint'). active false = not declared for this build (kept so the plan's list stays visible). Polygons go in polygon_lonlat ([lon, lat] pairs, WGS84; the gate projects them with data/centerline.local.json's origin, so they never depend on a build's frame) or polygon_xz (the gate OBJ's own frame, metres, x east, z north). Stations are metres along the V3 paint centreline from the pylons (track.config.json's frame), approximate where marked ~, as anchors for the author only: the gate reads the polygon, never the station.
_pavement_prefixes_doc: Which built groups are pavement: every drivable road (1ROAD*, the ribbon and anything authored drivable) and the C-470 deck slabs, which are visual-only (no prefix) but are paved road all the same (D5: 'named AUTH_overpass_*, never HIGHWAY*'). HIGHWAY* / HWYSTRUCT* / MOUNTAINS* are refused outright by name, exemption or not.
